contents.name: Finite-range lattice spin interactions, finite-volume Gibbs weights and Ising transfer matrix

contents.name: Cylinder topology, finite-alphabet configuration space, measure extension and compactness
contents.support: The relevant complete treatments are in Chapter 6 and its measure-construction appendix; the local proof supplies its own clopen-cylinder premeasure argument and states the exact Countable Choice use.

contents.name: Gibbs specifications, proper kernels, DLR measures and finite-volume consistency
contents.support: Supports the terminology and model context; the local definition and consistency proof spell out measurability, properness and the finite-range energy split.

contents.name: DLR existence by subsequential finite-volume limits
contents.support: Chapter 6 gives the existence route; the local proof checks local-kernel continuity and carries the exact compactness and Countable Choice premises.

contents.name: Dobrushin influence criterion and boundary influence
contents.support: The complete source proof is inspected; the local proof uses a separately constructed maximal coupling with its own half-total-variation normalization.

contents.name: Two-dimensional Peierls contours and energy injection
contents.support: PDF pp. 127–132 gives the full contour estimate and flip injection; the local proof uses a separately justified mod-2 parity separation argument and conservative cycle count.

contents.name: Stationary entropy/energy density and DLR variational pressure
contents.support: Supports the bounded-lattice variational framework; the local statement is one-way (DLR implies variational equilibrium) and does not assert a minimizer-to-DLR converse.

contents.name: One-dimensional Ising transfer matrix and conditional Gibbs state
contents.support: Chapter 3 and Chapter 6 support the exact finite-chain and DLR context; the local bridge proof gives the positive eigenvector and endpoint-uniform limit explicitly.

contents.name: Conditional pressure, entropy units and Ising model predictions
contents.support: Provides formal statistical-mechanics context only; the local physics theorem remains conditional on the named model postulate and exact SI reference conventions.
